headline: Wylie Dog Design System
tagline: A typed component library and OKLCH token system built to close the gap between design and code.

overview.body: Wylie Dog is a production design system built for a growing product team shipping across web and native surfaces. The work spans a three-tier token architecture, a Figma-synced pipeline, and a component library built on accessible primitives — replacing a patchwork of one-off styles with a single source of truth every team can build from.

left.alt: The design system's overview page in light mode

right.alt: The same overview page in dark mode

sections.heading: One system, every surface.
sections.body: Every button, input, and layout primitive now traces back to the same token set — in Figma and in code. New features ship faster because the underlying pieces no longer need to be re-invented per screen.
